from datetime import datetime

token = apis.spotify.login(username='ch-burch@gmail.com', password='99W1c[K')['access_token']

# 1) Fetch all song library songs
library_songs=[]
page_index=0
page_limit=20
while True:
    page = apis.spotify.show_song_library(access_token=token,page_index=page_index,page_limit=page_limit)
    if not page:
        break
    library_songs.extend(page)
    page_index += 1

library_song_ids=[s['song_id'] for s in library_songs]
print('library song records:', len(library_song_ids))

# release_date mapping for library songs
library_release={}
for sid in sorted(set(library_song_ids)):
    det=apis.spotify.show_song(song_id=sid)
    library_release[sid]=det.get('release_date')

library_remove_ids=[sid for sid,rd in library_release.items() if rd and int(rd[:4])<2021]
print('library_remove_ids (release<2021):', sorted(library_remove_ids), 'count', len(library_remove_ids))

# 2) Fetch playlists in library
playlists=[]
page_index=0
page_limit=20
while True:
    page = apis.spotify.show_playlist_library(access_token=token,page_index=page_index,page_limit=page_limit)
    if not page:
        break
    playlists.extend(page)
    page_index += 1
print('playlists in library:', len(playlists))
print('playlist ids:', [p['playlist_id'] for p in playlists])

# Map release dates for all unique song ids appearing in playlists
all_playlist_song_ids=[]
for p in playlists:
    all_playlist_song_ids.extend(p.get('song_ids',[]))
unique_playlist_song_ids=sorted(set(all_playlist_song_ids))
print('unique playlist song ids:', len(unique_playlist_song_ids))

playlist_release={}
for sid in unique_playlist_song_ids:
    det=apis.spotify.show_song(song_id=sid)
    playlist_release[sid]=det.get('release_date')

# Determine which song ids in each playlist are release<2021
playlist_remove_pairs=[]
per_playlist={}
for p in playlists:
    pid=p['playlist_id']
    song_ids=p.get('song_ids',[])
    remove_in_playlist=[sid for sid in song_ids if playlist_release.get(sid) and int(playlist_release[sid][:4])<2021]
    per_playlist[pid]=sorted(set(remove_in_playlist))
    for sid in remove_in_playlist:
        playlist_remove_pairs.append((pid,sid))

# Deduplicate pairs (if duplicates somehow)
playlist_remove_pairs_unique=sorted(set(playlist_remove_pairs))
print('playlist_remove song_ids per playlist:')
for pid,ids in per_playlist.items():
    if ids:
        print('  playlist',pid,'count',len(ids),'ids',ids)
print('total unique playlist removal pairs:', len(playlist_remove_pairs_unique))

from collections import defaultdict

# Login
pw = None
for x in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords():
    if x['account_name']=='spotify':
        pw = x['password']
print('spotify_pw_len', len(pw))

token = apis.spotify.login(username='ch-burch@gmail.com', password=pw)['access_token']

# Fetch all songs in library
library_songs=[]
page_index=0
page_limit=20
while True:
    page = apis.spotify.show_song_library(access_token=token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    if not page:
        break
    library_songs.extend(page)
    page_index += 1
library_song_ids = sorted({s['song_id'] for s in library_songs})
print('library songs now (records)', len(library_songs), 'unique', len(library_song_ids))

# Determine which library songs still have release year < 2021
lib_bad_ids=[]
for sid in library_song_ids:
    det = apis.spotify.show_song(song_id=sid)
    rd = det.get('release_date')
    if rd and int(rd[:4]) < 2021:
        lib_bad_ids.append((sid, det.get('title'), rd))
print('library songs still released before 2021:', len(lib_bad_ids))
print('library bad ids:', [x[0] for x in lib_bad_ids])

# Fetch all playlists in library
playlists=[]
page_index=0
page_limit=20
while True:
    page = apis.spotify.show_playlist_library(access_token=token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    if not page:
        break
    playlists.extend(page)
    page_index += 1
print('playlists now', len(playlists))

# For each playlist, find songs with release year < 2021
playlist_bad = defaultdict(list)
for p in playlists:
    pid = p['playlist_id']
    for sid in set(p.get('song_ids',[])):
        det = apis.spotify.show_song(song_id=sid)
        rd = det.get('release_date')
        if rd and int(rd[:4]) < 2021:
            playlist_bad[pid].append((sid, det.get('title'), rd))

bad_total = sum(len(v) for v in playlist_bad.values())
print('total playlist songs still released before 2021:', bad_total)
for pid, items in sorted(playlist_bad.items()):
    print(' playlist', pid, 'count', len(items), 'ids', [i[0] for i in items])
